gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.

gaps.lead: 'Why don't we hold the wedding outdoors?' said Ana.
gaps.explanation: suggest + that-clause, or suggest + -ing: suggested they hold / suggested holding.

gaps.lead: As I get older, I become less patient.
gaps.sentence: The older I get, ___ I become.
gaps.explanation: The older…, the more… — doubled comparatives for parallel change.

gaps.lead: The soup needed a little more salt.
gaps.explanation: needed a little more = didn't have enough (salt).

gaps.lead: My grandfather had completely forgotten that he phoned me last night.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather didn't ___ phoning me last night.
gaps.explanation: 'Completely forgotten' becomes 'didn't have any recollection of'.

gaps.lead: You can borrow the car, but you must drive it carefully.
gaps.sentence: You can borrow the car ___ it carefully.
